name: services/progs/programmes
description: Get information on multiple stidy programmes at once.
brief_description: Get information on multiple study programmes.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of programme method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary.

  • Your programme_ids will be mapped to the keys of the dictionary.
  • The values will be either null (if the programme doesn't exist), or a dictionary in the same format as the one returned in the programme method.
